Roof Eidam & Maycock increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 14.47% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Roof Eidam & Maycock bought 3,116 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 24,652 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.14M, up from 21,536 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Roof Eidam & Maycock who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $923.56B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $187.9. About 19.51M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
